classifications.statement: PROPERTY_TYPE is the second field in the retained canonical 25-column header.
classifications.rationale: The retained data-scope execution records the same 25-label header for all four canonical CSV members and places PROPERTY_TYPE second, while the canonical runner uses zero-based PROPERTY_TYPE_INDEX = 1.
classifications.proof_boundary: Supports the retained canonical four-member header and current runner mapping only; it is not a claim about an unobserved future source revision.

classifications.statement: Every non-ZZZZ PROPERTY_TYPE value must be exactly two uppercase ASCII letters followed by two digits.
classifications.rationale: The repository records and enforces the AA99-or-ZZZZ regex, but implementation and proposal assertions do not prove that this is the complete authoritative grammar of every possible SCO PROPERTY_TYPE value. No retained authority content in the approved offline inputs establishes the universal AA99 rule.
classifications.proof_boundary: The regex remains an implemented semantic assumption, not an authority-proven complete source grammar.

classifications.statement: ZZZZ is a valid special PROPERTY_TYPE token.
classifications.rationale: The current runner permits ZZZZ and the semantic proposal records the same regex, but the retained offline evidence does not contain an archived authority statement establishing ZZZZ as a valid California SCO PROPERTY_TYPE token.
classifications.proof_boundary: Presence in code or a proposal proves implementation intent only, not external semantic authority.

classifications.statement: California uses insurance PROPERTY_TYPE codes IN01-IN08 and IN99 as recorded by the semantic proposal.
classifications.rationale: The semantic proposal explicitly records IN01-IN08 and IN99 and cites an SCO NAUPA authority URL, but the authority document content is not retained as an immutable repository evidence artifact within the approved offline inputs. The repository assertion therefore cannot be elevated to direct offline proof.
classifications.proof_boundary: Records the repository's attributed external-authority assertion only; it does not independently verify the external document.

classifications.statement: The custom PROPERTY_TYPE projector matches csv.reader on the committed deterministic standard-CSV matrix only.
classifications.rationale: The committed privacy-safe synthetic differential test compares the custom projector with Python csv.reader(strict=True) across the defined ordinary, quoting, comma, escaped-quote, embedded-newline, embedded-CRLF and quote-all cases, and the audit records that no mismatch was reproduced for that matrix.
classifications.proof_boundary: Support is limited to the committed deterministic synthetic matrix and must not be generalized to universal CSV dialect compatibility or to the unseen offending source row.
